response.sql: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_base, account_base * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_base) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_accounts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.account_base) AS combined_account_base, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_share_above_average FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value

assumptions.assumption: Account base means the number of Accounts rows. The primary query includes states whose customers have no accounts, with an account base and share of zero; NULL state values form one group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only states represented by customers who hold at least one account when calculating the plain average of state shares.
